settings.content: Home page only. After you stop scrolling, the nearest section eases into place under the header.

settings.label: Snap zone
settings.info: How close a section top must be (as % of screen height) before it snaps.

settings.label: Snap speed
settings.info: Longer feels softer.

settings.content: Surfboards are sold online for in-store pickup only. These settings control the pickup notice on product pages and the pickup-day step in the cart.

settings.label: Pickup-only product tag
settings.info: Any product with this tag is treated as pickup only.

settings.label: Pickup-only collection handles
settings.info: Products in these collections are also treated as pickup only, and these collection pages show a pickup notice. Comma separated, for example: all-surfboards, longboards. Leave blank to use the tag only.

settings.label: Pickup window (days)
settings.info: Boards must be collected within this many days of purchase. Leave blank to make no promise about a window.

settings.label: Shop phone number
settings.info: Shows a Call the shop link. Leave blank to hide it.

settings.label: Pickup hours
settings.info: Shown in the pickup notice and the cart, for example: daily, 10am to 5pm Pacific time. Leave blank to hide.

settings.label: Closed weekdays
settings.info: Comma separated, for example: Mon, Tue. Blocks those days in the pickup date.

settings.label: Closed dates
settings.info: Comma separated, YYYY-MM-DD, for example: 2026-12-25, 2026-12-26.

settings.content: Short delivery lines on product pages and in the cart. Canada only. Information only, they never change a price.

settings.label: Last order day for Christmas delivery (Canada)
settings.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD. The line disappears the day after.

settings.label: Show free shipping line and cart progress bar
Free shipping threshold (CAD)
settings.info: Display only. Your Shopify shipping rates decide the real threshold, so keep this in step with them.

settings.label: Mobile sticky add-to-cart bar on product pages
Returns note (cart page)
settings.info: One short sentence about your returns and exchanges. Shown in the reassurance row under the cart. Leave blank to hide it.

settings.label: Falling snow effect
settings.info: Soft red and sand flakes across the page. Skipped automatically for visitors who ask for reduced motion and on low-power phones.

settings.label: Snow last day
settings.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD. The snow stops after this day.

settings.content: Small extras shown in the cart, the cart drawer and under the Add to cart button. Only in-stock, single-option, non-board products are shown, and never something already in the cart.

settings.label: Collection handles
settings.info: Comma separated, in priority order. The first ones fill the row first.

settings.label: Items in the cart and product page

settings.content: Product cards can show the flat lay / studio photo or the model photo first (set per section: open a product card's image block and use Card photo). The theme finds a flat lay by looking for these words in the photo's alt text or file name.

settings.label: Flat lay markers
settings.info: Comma separated. A photo whose alt text or file name contains one of these is treated as a flat lay / studio photo.
